response.rationale: The physical exam and echocardiogram demonstrate mirror-image cardiac anatomy (dextrocardia with situs inversus), which explains the ECG findings as a secondary phenomenon. R1 only describes the ECG pattern without addressing the underlying anatomy.

rejected.why: It is a manifestation of the underlying dextrocardia, not the most likely diagnosis.
